create_frame_apply: create a frame apply object to apply a function along rows or columns of a DataFrame
create_execution_engine: create a custom execution engine class with map and apply methods for JIT or parallel apply operations
run_named_aggregation: run named aggregation on a DataFrame or GroupBy with relabeled output columns using **kwargs
validate_func_kwargs: validate named aggregation kwargs to ensure aggfuncs are strings or callables
relabel_aggregation_result: relabel and reorder aggregation results by mapping new column names and column order
